svg.text: Demo tier HLD — three agents with three-tier memory
ADR-0015 runtime + ADR-0017 agents and memory (accepted 2026-10-31) · scale to zero · designed, not deployed until the S10 entry criteria pass
AWS · us-east-1 · no VPC, no NAT · every stateful component
billed per use · nothing runs while idle
Lambda worker · one attempt per delivery
3 GB · reserved 3 · ~38 s run · timeout 5 min

g.text: claim attempt + 1 · fenced commit · deadline · model pinned per run
LangGraph state in RAM · snapshot_hash, chunk ids, payload_ref only
DynamoDB items · one run · TTL 14 d
effect journal · key = sha256(run, node, model,
OpenSearch Serverless · index per release · alias
a memo is never evidence; no episodic memory
model pinned per run · calls journaled
MWAA Serverless → Fargate task per step
EDGAR ≤ 8 req/s · vectors to S3 first

svg.text: Resume rule: a redelivered job loads the last checkpoint and runs only the interrupted agent; journaled calls are reused; evidence is read by hash.
Fencing: checkpoint, journal, envelope and result writes all fail if a newer attempt owns the job, so a zombie attempt cannot fork history.
Region loss is a documented outage (ADR-0006); no stateful component lives outside us-east-1.
